title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
raw_excerpt: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.
summary: OpenAI 发布研究称 GPT-6 模型具备内生的蛋白质设计能力：模型通过推理与写代码来设计蛋白质结构与序列，无需专门微调。实验室湿实验验证显示，在五个靶点上都观察到了结合证据。这是大模型从文本走向真实科学发现的重要一步，也说明通用推理能力可以直接迁移到结构生物学任务上。

title: 智谱刚刚发了GLM-5.4，全新架构的那种！网友直呼：超过预期

title: Amazon snaps up Decart's AI optimization tech for $7.5B as it prepares to sell Trainium chips
raw_excerpt: Amazon has acquired the technology behind the Decart Optimization Stack (DOS), as well as Decart's founding team and team of AI researchers and engineers, for $7.5 billion. Decart has made a name for itself by building interactive real-time models and AI video-generation tools. Its DOS software helps AI models run efficiently on Nvidia, Amazon, and Google's hardware. More efficient compute means better training, better reinforcement learning, faster inference, and better models for customers at a lower cost.
summary: 亚马逊以 75 亿美元收购 Decart 的 AI 优化技术（DOS 栈）及其创始团队和研究员团队。Decart 以实时交互模型和 AI 视频生成见长，其 DOS 软件能让模型在英伟达、亚马逊和谷歌硬件上更高效运行。此举发生在亚马逊准备对外销售 Trainium 芯片之际，意在用更高效的算力软件栈为自研芯片背书。

title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO, and Board Director
raw_excerpt: NVIDIA reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO, and Board Director following unanimous Board approval and US government input confirming no national security risk. A committee of independent directors is investigating claims of Huang being targeted by foreign intelligence and will proceed with legal counsel's support. NVIDIA is forming a National Security and Export Control Committee and will appoint a Chief Compliance Officer to enhance oversight.
summary: 英伟达董事会全票通过，恢复黄仁勋总裁、CEO 及董事职务，此前美国政府方面确认不存在国家安全风险。董事会将成立独立委员会调查黄仁勋遭外国情报机构针对的说法，并新设国家安全与出口管制委员会、任命首席合规官。这场持续 11 天的风波以股价单日暴涨逾 31% 收场，是本周 AI 圈最大的公司治理事件。

title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
raw_excerpt: Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen . The move comes just months after Tidal began labeling and demonetizing tracks identified as 100 percent AI-generated. In a post on X, Andersen says Tidal needed to take a more "drastic" measure, as AI music made up 43 percent of the tracks distributed to the platform in the last 90 days. summary: Tidal 宣布自 12 月 9 日起正式禁止 AI 生成音乐，将删除约 2900 万首 AI 曲目，并预计每天拒收 8 万至 8.5 万首。Tidal 音乐负责人 Robert Andersen 称，过去 90 天分发到平台的曲目中 AI 音乐占比高达 43%，此前仅做标注和取消变现已不够，必须采取更激烈措施。这是主流流媒体平台对 AI 音乐最严厉的一次清退。

title: Data centers are getting their own natural gas power plants
raw_excerpt: One of the biggest roadblocks to starting up a data center is getting approval to connect to the electric grid—a wait that could last as long as a decade. Some developers aren’t willing to wait and are instead opting to build their own off-grid, or behind-the-meter, gas power plants to fuel the AI boom. xAI’s Memphis campus has famously used dozens of natural gas turbines, some of them without permits, as far back as 2024. At the time, that facility was a rarity, and it faced scrutiny from regulators. It remains the subject of ongoing legal battles . But the strategy of going off-grid for power has since become a lot more common. As of October 2026, data center developers have announced plans for more than 100 behind-the-meter gas power plants at facilities in the US, according to data from Cleanview, a market intelligence company. The facilities have a combined planned capacity of over 115 gigawatts, more than double the peak power demand of California. The vast majority of these announcements have come since the beginning of 2025. It’s possible that not all these facilities will be built; only a small fraction are under construction or operating today. But there’s a growing trend of large data centers looking to build their own power supply, and this could shape the grid—and its climate impacts—for decades to come. Building your own power plant is generally more expensive than just hooking up to the grid, but the AI rush has made developers willing to pay a significant pre…
summary: MIT 科技评论调查指出，并网审批可能长达十年，正迫使数据中心开发商自建离网燃气电厂。截至 2026 年 10 月，美国已宣布逾 100 个此类数据中心配套燃气电站项目。xAI 孟菲斯园区早在 2024 年就使用数十台燃气轮机、部分未获许可，至今仍在诉讼中。这揭示了 AI 算力扩张与能源监管之间的结构性冲突。

title: Supercharging transformer residual connections
raw_excerpt: Google's DeepCrossAttention (DCA) enhances transformer residual connections by allowing each layer to dynamically select and route features from preceding layers, reducing information dilution and parameter count by 30-40%. Unlike traditional residual connections, DCA uses dynamic routing and depth-wise cross-attention mechanisms to achieve faster convergence and better quality with minimal parameter increase. Tested on large datasets like C4 and LM1B, DCA improves training efficiency and perplexity compared to standard models, proving a shift towards dynamic residual routing for scalable LLMs.
summary: 谷歌研究提出 DeepCrossAttention（DCA），改造 Transformer 残差连接：让每一层动态选择并路由来自前面各层的特征，缓解信息稀释，同时减少 30–40% 参数量。在 C4、LM1B 等大规模数据上，DCA 收敛更快、困惑度更优，且参数增量极小。这为「动态残差路由」替代固定残差连接提供了有力证据。

title: Faster Quantum Algorithms with Agents and Formal Verification
raw_excerpt: Google DeepMind used teams of Gemini 4 agents to find cheaper versions of known quantum algorithms, with each result proven correct in the Lean theorem prover. One circuit for fusion energy research cut its computing cost by 11.8x.
summary: 谷歌 DeepMind 用 Gemini 4 智能体团队搜索已知量子算法的更廉价实现，每个结果都在 Lean 定理证明器中完成正确性验证。其中一个用于聚变能源研究的量子线路把计算成本降低 11.8 倍。该工作把「智能体搜索 + 形式化验证」组合成可信任的算法发现流水线，是 AI for Science 方法论上的一个可复用范式。
